rationale: Hotai Motor is a mixed-industry consolidated group whose Hotai Insurance subsidiary adopted IFRS 17 from 2026-01-01. The official 2026Q1 report retrospectively restates the 2025Q1 comparative group results. The original 2025Q1 report shows parent-attributable net income of 4,307,781 thousand and basic EPS of 7.73 using 557,103 thousand weighted-average shares. The restated 2025Q1 comparative shows parent-attributable net income of 3,974,710 thousand and basic EPS of 7.13 using the same 557,103 thousand shares. The difference is therefore an accounting-basis restatement, not a share-count adjustment. Existing 2025Q2, Q3, and annual EPS facts remain from the pre-IFRS-17 group reporting basis and cannot be combined with the restated 2025Q1 and 2026Q1 facts to produce a current-comparable TTM EPS or PE.

MOPS official 2207 2026Q1 consolidated Inline XBRL; current basic EPS is 7.95 and the retrospectively restated 2025Q1 comparative basic EPS is 7.13.
MOPS official 2207 2025Q1 consolidated PDF. Page 54 reports parent-attributable net income of 4,307,781 thousand, 557,103 thousand weighted-average shares, and basic EPS of 7.73.

MOPS official 2207 2026Q1 consolidated PDF. Page 11 reports current basic EPS of 7.95 and restated comparative basic EPS of 7.13; pages 16-17 state that Hotai Insurance adopted IFRS 17 from 2026-01-01 and retrospectively restated all periods presented; page 73 reports restated comparative parent-attributable net income of 3,974,710 thousand using the same 557,103 thousand weighted-average shares.

observations.description: The official transition note states that Hotai Insurance adopted IFRS 17 from 2026-01-01 and retrospectively applied the standard to every reporting period presented in the 2026Q1 consolidated report.

The original and restated 2025Q1 EPS notes both use 557,103 thousand weighted-average shares, while parent-attributable net income changes from 4,307,781 to 3,974,710 thousand and basic EPS changes from 7.73 to 7.13. This directly rules out share scaling as the cause.
The 2026Q1 consolidated statement of changes in equity reports a 725,510 thousand total 2025-01-01 IFRS 17 transition increase, of which 725,426 thousand is attributable to owners of the parent.

The available 2026Q1 filing supplies a restated 2025Q1 comparative, but no same-basis restated 2025Q2 discrete/YTD, Q3 discrete/YTD, or annual EPS facts. Pre-transition 2025 filings therefore remain as-reported evidence only and cannot form a current-comparable TTM series.
